translations.web: Don’t eat the food of him who has a stingy eye, and don’t crave his delicacies:
translations.bsb: Do not eat the bread of a stingy man, and do not crave his delicacies;
translations.kjv: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, neither desire thou his dainty meats:
translations.asv: Eat thou not the bread of him that hath an evil eye, Neither desire thou his dainties:
